A gem (onyx) intaglio from a signet ring or seal matrix of Roman date, about AD 50 - 150. It has previously been examined and published by Martin Henig in his "A Corpus of Roman Engraved Gemstones From British Sites" (1874, 1978 and 2007) as number app. 44. and illustarted in Plates, series A.
